results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the total revenue?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('completed', 'shipped') LIMIT 200

results.question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many orders were placed per month?
results.sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the average order value?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' LIMIT 200

results.question: Which product categories generate the most revenue?
results.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What are the highest rated products with at least 3 reviews?
results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: How many orders are in each status?
results.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the monthly revenue trend?
results.sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

results.question: Which product has the most reviews?
results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which orders are still pending?
results.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY order_date LIMIT 200

results.question: What are the 10 most recent orders?
results.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: What payment methods do customers use, and how many payments used each?
results.sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: What is the average product rating?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews LIMIT 200

results.question: What are the most expensive products?
results.sql: SELECT name, price, category FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many products do we sell?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products LIMIT 200

results.question: How many reviews have been written?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews LIMIT 200

results.question: Which customers spent the most on Electronics products?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS electronics_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY electronics_spend DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What are the largest orders by value?
results.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10
